The official weather of **Hungary** in Gladys, from the open data of **HungaroMet** (formerly OMSZ),
the Hungarian Meteorological Service: the readings of the nearest **automatic weather station**
every 10 minutes, and the **official weather warnings** of your county or district: the warnings
for the next 3 hours and the outlook for today and tomorrow.

Open data: no account, no API key. Database: Meteorological Database, HungaroMet Nonprofit Zrt.
This integration is not affiliated with HungaroMet.

## Overview

- **Two devices**: the nearest station (temperature, humidity, pressure, wind, gusts, wind
  direction, rain intensity, visibility) and the warnings of your county, or of your district for
  the 3-hour warnings.
- **A scene trigger**, "New HungaroMet warning", as soon as a warning is issued for the next 3
  hours, today or tomorrow.
- **A dashboard widget** with the readings and the warnings.
- **Read-only**: HungaroMet is a data source, nothing is controlled.

The [Meteoalarm](https://github.com/guim31/gladys-meteoalarm) integration also shows the Hungarian
warnings, by county, through the European Meteoalarm feed. This one reads HungaroMet directly: it
adds the station readings and the 3-hour warnings, which HungaroMet issues by district.

## Requirements

- Gladys **5.3.0** or later.
- A place in **Hungary**.
- Your Gladys house located on the map (**Settings → Houses**), or coordinates, a station or a
  county typed in the configuration.
- Gladys must reach the Internet (`odp.met.hu`).

## Configuration

Install the integration from **Integrations → Install from GitHub** (or from the store), then
open its configuration. Every field is optional: by default the integration takes the position of
your first located house, the station nearest to it and the warnings of its county, and refreshes
every 10 minutes.

| Field                           | Use                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| House                           | The house whose position is used. Empty: the first house that has a position.                                     |
| Latitude, Longitude             | Another place than a house, for example `47.50` and `19.04` (a comma works too). Both, or neither.                |
| Weather station                 | The number of a HungaroMet station, for example `44527` (Budapest Pestszentlőrinc). Empty: the nearest one.       |
| County of the warnings          | One of the 19 counties or Budapest. Empty: the county of the place.                                               |
| District of the 3-hour warnings | The name or code of a district (járás), for example `Pécsi` or `204`. Empty: the whole county.                    |
| Refresh interval                | 10, 20, 30 or 60 minutes. The stations report every 10 minutes.                                                   |
| Language of the feature names   | Language of the feature names (set when the devices are created) and of the scene event texts. French by default. |

The house position is read through the Gladys `location` permission, shown when you install the
integration. It never leaves Gladys: HungaroMet publishes whole-country files, and the nearest
station is computed in the integration. It is never written to the logs.

Then open the **Discovery** tab of the integration and add the two devices to Gladys.

## Devices

### Station

The name is "HungaroMet" followed by the station name. Values of the last 10-minute observation:

| Feature                  | Unit | Note                                                       |
| ------------------------ | ---- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| Temperature              | °C   | Air temperature                                            |
| Humidity                 | %    |                                                            |
| Pressure (station level) | hPa  | Pressure at the station altitude, not reduced to sea level |
| Wind speed               | km/h | 10-minute mean (converted from m/s)                        |
| Wind gusts               | km/h | Strongest gust of the last 10 minutes                      |
| Wind direction           | °    | Where the wind comes from: 0 = north, 90 = east            |
| Rain intensity           | mm/h | Rain of the last 10 minutes, as an hourly rate             |
| Visibility               | km   |                                                            |

A station that does not measure a value (many have no pressure or visibility sensor) leaves that
feature empty. A station silent for more than 3 hours is not re-published as current.

### Warnings

The name is "HungaroMet warnings" (in the language of the configuration) followed by the county or
district. HungaroMet issues the 3-hour warnings by district and the outlook by county; Budapest
takes the outlook of Pest county.

| Feature                   | Unit   | Note                                                                            |
| ------------------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Warning, next 3 hours     | 0 to 3 | Highest level in force: 0 none, 1 yellow, 2 orange, 3 red (district, or county) |
| Warning outlook, today    | 0 to 3 | Highest level of today's outlook for the county                                 |
| Warning outlook, tomorrow | 0 to 3 | Highest level of tomorrow's outlook for the county                              |
| Weather warnings          | text   | Every warning, e.g. "Next 3 hours: Yellow · Wind gusts \| Today: Yellow · Rain" |

Without a district, "Warning, next 3 hours" is the highest level of all the districts of the
county. Warning types: thunderstorm, wind gusts, torrential rain, freezing rain, blowing snow, rain,
snowfall, dense fog, extreme cold, heat.

## Widget

**HungaroMet weather** shows, in the language and units of the dashboard:

- the station name (as named in Gladys), then its temperature, humidity, wind and gusts;
- the warnings of the next 3 hours, today and tomorrow, or a green "None" line;
- the source and the time of the observation.

Its **Blocks shown** setting hides the readings or the warnings.

## Scene trigger

**New HungaroMet warning** fires when HungaroMet issues a warning for the area, or raises the
level of one. A 3-hour warning fires again only once it was lifted then issued again; an outlook
warning fires once per day and type, whether first seen for tomorrow or for today. A restart does
not fire it again, and the very first start only takes note of the warnings already issued.

Filters (empty = any): **Warning types**, **Levels** (yellow, orange, red) and **When** (next 3
hours, today, tomorrow).

Information passed to the scene actions: warning type, level, when, level (1 to 3), the keys of
the type, level and when, level raised, official text (in English, unchanged) and district or
county. For example, a message: `HungaroMet: \{\{triggerEvent.data.level_label\}\}
\{\{triggerEvent.data.type_label\}\} warning (\{\{triggerEvent.data.horizon_label\}\})`.

## Configuration actions

- **List the nearest stations**: the 8 stations reporting now nearest to the place, with their
  number, county, altitude and distance. Copy a number into "Weather station" to choose another
  one.
- **Check the connection**: reads every source now and says what answered: the station temperature
  and its time, the number of warnings, and the districts of the county with their codes.

## Scene examples

- **Storm coming**: trigger "New HungaroMet warning", types "Thunderstorm" and "Wind gusts", when
  "Next 3 hours" → close the shutters, retract the awning, send a message.
- **Freezing rain tomorrow**: trigger "New HungaroMet warning", type "Freezing rain", when
  "Tomorrow" → remind to leave earlier and cover the windshield.
- **Hot afternoon**: when "Temperature" becomes greater than 30 °C → close the south-facing
  shutters.

## Troubleshooting

- **"No location"**: no house has a position. Place your house on the map in **Settings →
  Houses**, or type coordinates, a station or a county.
- **"More than 50 km from any HungaroMet station"**: the place is outside Hungary.
- **"The district is unknown"**: run **Check the connection**, it lists the districts of the county
  with their codes, then type one of them.
- **"HungaroMet does not answer"**: Gladys cannot reach `odp.met.hu`; the values are updated when it
  is back. The logs say which source fails, once, and when it works again.
- **A feature stays empty**: the station does not measure it. Choose another station with
  **List the nearest stations**.
- **More details**: set the `LOG_LEVEL` variable of the container to `debug`.

## Limits

- **Data**: open data of HungaroMet, free to use with the source cited ("Database: Meteorological
  Database, HungaroMet Nonprofit Zrt.", shown by the widget). The wind is converted from m/s to
  km/h and the rain to an hourly rate; the warnings and their official texts are passed on unchanged.
- **Requests**: about 20 small files an hour at the default pace (observations and the index of the
  3-hour warnings every refresh, the outlook indexes every 30 minutes, a warning file only when a
  new one is issued, the station list once a day). HungaroMet publishes no rate limit.
- One place, one station and one area per installation.
- The feature names are set when the devices are created: changing the language later does not
  rename them.
- The official texts of the warnings are in English (HungaroMet also publishes them in Hungarian).
- Tested against the real HungaroMet files, but not yet on a real Gladys instance: feedback welcome.

## Configuration settings

These are the settings HungaroMet asks for in its configuration screen in Gladys.

| Setting | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HungaroMet | `section` | No | Open data of HungaroMet, the Hungarian Meteorological Service: no account, no key. By default, the integration uses the position of your first Gladys house: the nearest weather station and the warnings of its county. Database: Meteorological Database, HungaroMet Nonprofit Zrt. Not affiliated with HungaroMet. |
| House | `select` | No | The house whose position is used. Empty: the first house with a position. |
| Latitude (optional) | `string` | No | To use another place than a house. Takes precedence over the house. |
| Longitude (optional) | `string` | No |  |
| Weather station (optional) | `string` | No | Number of a HungaroMet station. Empty: the nearest one. The action below lists them. |
| County of the warnings (optional) | `select` | No | Empty: the county of the place. Budapest takes the outlook of Pest county. |
| District of the 3-hour warnings (optional) | `string` | No | Name or code of a district (járás). Empty: the whole county. The connection check lists them. |
| Refresh interval | `select` | No | The stations report every 10 minutes. |
| Language of the feature names | `select` | No | Used when the devices are created, and for the scene event texts. |

## How to install HungaroMet in Gladys

1. In Gladys, open **Integrations**: HungaroMet appears in the catalog, next to the native integrations, with a community badge.
2. Click **Install**. Gladys pulls the Docker image (`ghcr.io/guim31/gladys-hungaromet:1.0.0`), starts it in a sandbox isolated from the core, and generates the integration's interface (devices, discovery and configuration).
3. Open the **Configuration** screen of the integration, fill in the settings, and save.
4. You can also install it directly from its repository URL: [https://github.com/guim31/gladys-hungaromet](https://github.com/guim31/gladys-hungaromet).

HungaroMet requires Gladys `>=5.3.0`. The catalog inside Gladys refreshes every hour, so a new version becomes available at most one hour after its release.

Not running Gladys yet? It is free and open source: [follow the installation guide](/docs/) to get started.
